summary_text: On 2026-05-22 (weekday), one order of Nestlé CERELAC Wheat Apple Carrot Baby Food Cereal (300 g) was purchased in the morning. This timing aligns with general population behavior, as 32.46% of shoppers purchase during this daypart. The product is a nutrient-fortified infant cereal, indicating a need for age-appropriate complementary feeding for a baby aged 6+ months. This is a single observation on one date; it is not yet possible to establish stable brand preferences, routine purchasing patterns, or specific brand loyalty for Nestlé Cerelac versus other infant cereal brands.
